envelope.description: The analyzer's search lookups use the complete mode

body.title: The analyzer's search lookups use the complete mode
body.summary: Make runSearchText in src/analyze/explore/search-text.ts and config-trace.ts call runGrepSearch with the complete flag, ignore any topK, raise a timeout or a search that could not run as the existing failed lookup output carrying the hits gathered, and write each distinct by-rule exclusion once in the completeness record's basisNote with no limited entry for hits, lines or files.
acceptanceChecks: search.text and config.trace return every hit with its whole line and no limited entry
A timed-out search is the failed lookup output with its gathered hits, not an empty or complete result

tests.name: completeness-all-lookups.test.ts: search.text and config.trace return every hit with its whole line and no limited entry, and a timed-out search is the failed lookup output with its gathered hits
